title: A Systematic Review of NeurIPS Dataset Management Practices
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a systematic review of dataset management practices and does not conduct any benchmark measurements, particularly none related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its findings are focused on general dataset management practices, including provenance, distribution, ethical disclosures (related to privacy, representativeness, and misuse), and licensing.
